From: peter@casteleyn-kitchens.be
Subject: catching up + a few things

Hi Michiel, hope the summer is treating you well. It has been hectic here since the trade fair - we had record footfall in the showroom and Rita still talks about how many visitors asked whether we were 'the kitchen people with the chatbot', so the marketing effect alone was worth it. I also finally read that book you recommended about service design, good stuff, though I skimmed the middle chapters. Anyway, a few loose ends from my side. We are still thinking about the phase-two ideas you sketched, no decision yet, the board wants to see this year's numbers first. Oh, and before I forget - since this morning the webshop assistant answers every single customer question with an error message, and the web orders that normally come in via that flow have basically stopped, so we are losing sales as we speak. Rita tried turning the widget off and on again but no luck. Also, on a completely different note, our webshop supplier mentioned they are moving everyone to a new platform next year, I have no clue if that affects anything on your side, no rush on that one at all. And if you are ever near Deinze, drop by the showroom, the new espresso machine alone is worth the detour. We should also plan that lunch we keep postponing. Kind regards, Peter
